desktop-sorted.bim
  The model.bim Power BI Desktop 2.160.1151.0 (Store edition, fr-FR UI) wrote on 2026-11-25
  when it saved a PBIP project. The project was BIcraft's own synthetic model: the interaction
  oracle's star model (testsupport/interaction_oracle/model.bim) plus a Calendar hierarchy and a
  Readers role, written with the keys of every JSON object in reverse order. Desktop opened the
  project, its ribbon's Save button was invoked through UI Automation, and its TMDL upgrade
  prompt was answered "do not upgrade", so the project kept a model.bim. Desktop raised the
  compatibility level and added lineage tags and annotations; the file is stored unchanged
  except for its line endings (Desktop wrote CRLF, .gitattributes stores LF).

tom-props.bim
  TOM's JsonSerializer output for the "every property set" model of the maintainers'
  development oracles (docs/formats/tmdl.md "Property order").

tom-props.pbip.bim
  tom-props.bim with every object's keys sorted by the rule observed in desktop-sorted.bim
  (`name` first, then ordinal order, at every depth; arrays unchanged). It was not itself saved
  by Desktop: Desktop no longer opens that compatibility-level-1000000 model as a project.

sales.bim
  A synthetic model written for BIcraft's tests.
